vision_findings.raw_extraction: WITH pg_payments AS (SELECT pg_txn_id, paid_amount FROM pg_settlement_raw WHERE trade_date = TRUNC(SYSDATE)-1 AND status='PAID'), ledger_charged AS (SELECT pg_txn_id, SUM(charge_amount) charged FROM cookie_ledger WHERE ledger_type='CHARGE' GROUP BY pg_txn_id) SELECT … CASE WHEN ABS(p.paid_amount-NVL(l.charged,0))<10000 THEN 'AUTO_CLEAR' …

권고: 임계값 적정성 분기 재평가 — Inquiry + 임계값 변경이력 Inspection.

권고: PROMO_RULE_HIST 100% 인용 검토 + RC-SET-002 메이커-체커 가동.
